locations.title: Locations
locations.description: One search per town, city, area or postcode district, e.g. Manchester, Clapham, Bristol, SW11, Cornwall. Matched with Rightmove's own place search.

operation.title: Buy or rent
operation.description: Property for sale or to rent.

searchUrls.title: Or Rightmove search URLs
searchUrls.description: Search pages copied from rightmove.co.uk with your area and filters set (drawn areas, keywords, any filter). Filters below do not apply to these.

radiusMiles.title: Radius (miles)
radiusMiles.description: Include properties within this distance of the location.

minPrice.title: Minimum price (£)
minPrice.description: Optional. For rent this is per calendar month.

maxPrice.title: Maximum price (£)
maxPrice.description: Optional. For rent this is per calendar month.

propertyTypes.title: Property types
propertyTypes.description: Any of: detached, semi-detached, terraced, flat, bungalow, land, park-home. Empty keeps all.

mustHave.title: Must have
mustHave.description: Any of: garden, parking, newHome, retirement, sharedOwnership, auction.

addedWithinDays.title: Added to site within
addedWithinDays.description: Only properties added in this window. Last 24 hours on a daily schedule collects new listings.

includeUnderOffer.title: Include under offer / let agreed
includeUnderOffer.description: Also include properties that are sold subject to contract, under offer or let agreed.

includeDetails.title: Full description and property details
includeDetails.description: Reads each property page for the full description, floor area, full postcode, tenure and lease length, service charge, ground rent, council tax band, nearest stations, parking, garden, heating, floorplans and EPC. Costs $0.003 per property instead of $0.001.

maxItemsPerSearch.title: Max properties per search
maxItemsPerSearch.description: Stop each search after this many properties. Rightmove shows about 1,000 per search; bigger searches are split by price automatically.
